MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Part 4: Perception of Coordination Skill. Nine-item self-report Likert subscale (1=Strongly Disagree .. 7=Strongly Agree), administered post-experiment. From the Duorhythm questionnaire.

item_01.Description: I felt that I was in tune with what was happening in the game.

item_02.Description: I felt confident in responding to my partner's actions.

item_03.Description: I felt that I contributed effectively to our team's dynamics.

item_04.Description: I believed I understood the game's objectives clearly.

item_05.Description: I felt that I was able to anticipate my partner's actions and needs.

item_06.Description: I felt adaptable to changes in the game's scenarios.

item_07.Description: I was able to recover quickly from my own mistakes during the game.

item_08.Description: My actions in the game were well understood by my partner.

item_09.Description: I felt that I was proactive in coordinating my actions with my partner's needs.
